answer: No. Multiple complaints and a low luggage-capacity study score show this is a real usability issue across owners, not merely an older‑customer habit (see SIG-F70-EU-022, SIG-F70-EU-025 and EV-F70-EU-ST-29 and many feedback items). Some owners do praise trunk space or anticipate future EV packaging improvements, but that doesn’t negate current widespread problems; the requirement should stay.
suggested_change: Clarify requirement applies to all customer segments; mandate an interior shut button; keep 380 L VDA target for mainstream ICE/hybrid variants but measure EV variants separately with defined minimum usable-volume guidance and permit documented exceptions for specialist trims.
